data.name: Shreyansh
data.gender_notes: Shreyansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who possesses the lord of prosperity and wealth. The name Shreyansh is derived from the Sanskrit word shri, which means 'wealth' and ansh, meaning 'lord'. The name Shreyansh carries the meaning “Lord of Fortune, Prosperous One” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Shreyansh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of fortune, prosperous one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the divine grace of Lord Shri Krishna, the god of wealth and prosperity in Hinduism.
data.etymology: Shreyansh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Fortune, Prosperous One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Shreyansh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Shreyansh holds great significance in Hindu culture, as it is believed that possessing the lord of prosperity and wealth brings about success, good fortune, and an abundance of material blessings in life. It is a popular name among Hindu communities, particularly in India, as it reflects the values and aspirations of seeking prosperity and wealth. The name Shreyansh is also associated with the Hindu god Ganesha, who is known as the remover of obstacles and the god of new beginnings, adding to its cultural significance.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Shreyansh signifies the pursuit of inner wealth and prosperity, as well as external material blessings. The term 'shri' in the name represents the inner wealth of spiritual knowledge, inner peace, and the blessings of the gods. The 'ansh' represents the lord or the divine source of all wealth and prosperity, highlighting the importance of connecting with the divine and seeking spiritual guidance in one's pursuit of wealth and success. The name Shreyansh, therefore, embodies both the material and spiritual aspects of wealth and prosperity, inspiring individuals to strive for both internal and external growth and abundance.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Shreyansh: God of prosperity and success. Symbolizes the pursuit of infinite growth and progress in life. May the blessings of Shreyansh be upon you, bringing abundance and fulfillment.

historical_references.reference: Shreyansh was an ancient Hindu god associated with prosperity, fertility, and auspiciousness. He was believed to bring good fortune and was often invoked during religious rituals and celebrations.
historical_references.context: Ancient India, Vedic and Puranic literature

historical_references.reference: Shreyansh was also known as the god of the 28 nakshatras or lunar mansions. He was considered the ruling deity of the constellation of Rohini and was believed to grant boons related to prosperity, happiness, and wisdom to those born under this nakshatra.
